```{=html}
<div class="intro-text">
<p>"A toothache is agitation," Du Bois <a href="Volumes/01/01/Agitation.html">wrote in November 1910</a>, answering critics who urged silence. "Is a toothache a good thing? No.&nbsp;Is it therefore useless? No.&nbsp;It is supremely useful, for it tells the body of decay, dyspepsia and death." For twenty-four years he made <em>The Crisis</em> the toothache of American democracy: documenting lynching, tracking disfranchisement, connecting Jim Crow to empire, and building the case for Black citizenship in prose that could shift from forensic precision to prophetic fury within a single page.</p>
<p>This archive collects over 700 of those editorials, spanning the magazine's founding in 1910 through Du Bois's resignation in 1934. They can be <a href="browse.html">browsed by theme</a> or <a href="listing.html">read chronologically</a>.</p>
</div>
```

function shuffle(arr) {
  for (var i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    var j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    var temp = arr[i]; arr[i] = arr[j]; arr[j] = temp;
  }
  return arr;
}

function renderArticles() {
  shuffle(articles);
  var container = document.getElementById("article-pool");
  container.innerHTML = "";
  for (var i = 0; i < 6 && i < articles.length; i++) {
    var a = articles[i];
    var div = document.createElement("div");
    div.className = "start-here-item";
    div.innerHTML = '<div class="start-here-excerpt">' + a.excerpt + '</div>' +
      '<a href="' + a.url + '" class="start-here-title">' + a.title + '</a>' +
      '<span class="start-here-date"> · ' + a.date + '</span>';
    container.appendChild(div);
  }
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  renderArticles();
  document.getElementById("show-more").addEventListener("click", function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    renderArticles();
  });
});
</script>
